correctness.rationale: All 4096 subsets exhaustively classified by independent exact cycle predicates; 983 nonempty faces. Deterministic matching yields 471 pairs, one critical vertex and forty 4-cells. The full 3972-cover face-poset orientation topologically sorts, proving acyclicity; Forman establishes an integral wedge of forty 4-spheres. Independent mod-two boundary ranks agree. All 120 graph automorphisms exhaustively enumerated, group axioms checked, 10 conjugacy classes verified, and two different Lefschetz formulas agree on every element. Standard A5 character orthogonality gives the complex decomposition, invariant dimension zero and character inner product 17.

value.rationale: The icosahedral graph is a canonical vertex-transitive Platonic triangulation, and its vertex-induced forest complex naturally encodes complements of feedback vertex sets. Its complete nonpure, integer homotopy classification is not a face-count or textbook deduction. The full ten-class automorphism character and antipodal symmetry eigenspaces resolve genuinely additional topological representation data not inferable from the 40-sphere homotopy type alone. Graph specificity is a transparent limit rather than arbitrary parameter slicing.
